about: I’m a Brazilian-born web developer now thriving in the United States tech scene, with a Bachelor’s in Civil Engineering from the University of São Paulo. Over the past {year} years, I’ve honed my skills in Drupal front-end development, building responsive, accessible, and cross-browser sites for a diverse portfolio of clients.

My work focuses on building robust, scalabe front-end experiences using technologies like React, TypeScript, and modern CSS frameworks. I enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams, continuously learning, and turning ideas into real-world applications.

My passion lies in translating designs into pixel‑perfect, performant web interfaces—always prioritizing accessibility and user experience. I’m enthusiastic about clean code, inclusive design, and continuous learning.
